purpose: A Linux-portable offline preparation package. It freezes auditable method geometry, source identity, condition labels, and HBQ question IDs. It may preserve consistent owner assertions and raw bytes, but has no trust, native-provenance, dispatch, pairing, or promotion authority.

requirements: independent Linux evidence before any separate pairing decision

invariants: All planned conditions share the same source identity, method order, HBQ question IDs, and five-repetition schedule.
Prompts and schemas are not frozen by this planning artifact.
No paid fallback is allowed and no account, billing, payment, credit, or subscription setting may be changed.
The offline package performs no provider call, dispatch, acceptance, native-provenance labeling, promotion, or pairing; owner assertions are non-authoritative and raw responses remain untrusted.
interpretation_limits: This scaffold makes no HANNA alignment claim.
This one-story planning geometry makes no quality, validity, or general superiority claim.
Prompt/schema selection and actual native Linux execution remain outside this artifact; recorded raw responses are nonpairable until independently evidenced by a native Linux runtime.
